data.body: SECOND live capture, hours after the first: closing epic 9b71-55b3-1bd1-4a97. Primary verifier run exhausted on GENUINE BREADTH (requests=240, distinct_ratio_window=1.0, max_consecutive_repeat=1 — the c827 guard correctly did not fire; an epic spanning 7 children exceeds the flat budget). Recovery started and ONE evidence run hit its 20-request budget with a healthy profile (distinct_ratio_window=0.958) — and the whole recovery died again: 'bounded evidence recovery also failed', exit offered --force-close. This bug is now the single remaining blocker for closing the loop-breaker epic itself. Also folded the plan-review G6 finding into the plan: the catch set now includes token-exhaustion UnretryableOutputError (guarded by _is_token_exhaustion, mirroring run()), since an evidence run emitting past its output cap would otherwise reinstate the defect through a third exception class.
